a.lede: Meta's Muse agents continue to get new features and integrations. Spaces promises to be a new way to interact with the AI helpers.
a.title: Meta introduces Spaces, a new way to collaborate with your Muse agent

b.lede: Meta's AI agent can now take calls as a customizable animated avatar, ahead of the launch of a Tamagotchi-like wearable designed to bring Muse to life.
b.title: Meta says US users can now video chat with their Muse AI avatar
